title: Wick Liquor Ardour 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Wick Liquor Ardour is a deep and velvety fruit blend. It combines the rich, slightly tart taste of braised blackcurrant with a medley of dark forest berries and a smooth raspberry puree. This layered profile is bold, juicy, and packed with authentic berry character. Supplied in a 120ml bottle, this 100ml shortfill leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Mixed with a High-VG 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, this e-liquid is optimised for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense clouds and delivering the depth of flavour Wick Liquor is famous for. Wick Liquor is a premium boutique brand from Staffordshire, renowned for their unique "big block" approach to flavour and complex, layered blends.
